legend: The Oak Island Money Pit (Nova Scotia, Canada, 1795 legend)
lines: Oak Island, Nova Scotia, seventeen ninety-five.
A teenage boy finds a dip in the ground under an old oak.
A ship's pulley hangs from a branch above it.
He and two friends start digging.
Every ten feet down, they hit a platform of thick oak logs.
At ninety feet, legend says, a stone with strange symbols waits.
Then the pit floods with seawater, and the digging stops.
For over two hundred years, treasure hunters have tried to drain it.
Nobody has proved what is down there, if anything.
Pirate gold, or a clever trick? What do you think?
title: Oak Island: The Pit That Swallowed 200 Years of Treasure Hunters #shorts
description:
In 1795, a boy found a strange dip under an oak on Oak Island, and legend says a booby-trapped pit lies beneath. Pirate treasure, or a clever trick?
